policy: FREE_ONLY_NO_CARD_NO_TRIAL_CIRCUMVENTION; verify provider quotas and licenses at each use

providers.name: 3D Valley — biblioteca CC0 y generación web/API de pago
providers.role: Buscar y descargar recursos de la biblioteca CC0; la generación por API es de pago por créditos. La interfaz web puede tener herramientas gratuitas limitadas, pero no es una API gratuita ni una dependencia automatizable.
providers.free_tier: Biblioteca/API library gratuita con clave: 1.000 solicitudes/hora y 10.000/día; límites sin clave menores. Cada herramienta de generación/edición por API consume créditos (1 crédito = USD 0.01). Los enlaces de descarga/preview de la biblioteca funcionan sin clave. La interfaz web y sus herramientas gratuitas, si aparecen habilitadas, se consideran uso manual sujeto a los límites vigentes.
providers.api_key_required: Optional for public descriptions/download links; required for authenticated library search and API tools
constraints: Automatización permitida: consulta de biblioteca y descarga de recursos CC0; guardar ID original, URL exacta de origen, autor, licencia, fecha y SHA-256.

No invocar generate_model, edit_model, generate_texture ni otras herramientas de generación/edición vía API bajo la política cero costes: la documentación actual dice que cada herramienta consume créditos.
max_credits=0 es una salvaguarda contra gasto, no una prueba de que la operación sea gratuita; no usarlo para clasificar como gratis una herramienta que cobra créditos.
La generación gratuita que pudiera ofrecer la interfaz web debe ser manual, con comprobación visual del coste/cuota antes de cada uso, no un job automático ni scraping.
La biblioteca se atribuye a fuentes de terceros: verificar la ficha individual, su identificador de origen y licencia exacta antes de integrar.
Guardar RateLimit headers y respetar 429; no reintentar en bucle.
providers.quota: Library API with key: 1000 req/h, 10000 req/day (lower without key). Generation/edit API tools have no free quota: every call consumes credits.
providers.license_policy: Library assets listed CC0; verify the individual asset card and its original source identifier before integration.
providers.cost_policy: Library search/download endpoints free. Generation/edit API tools are PAID (1 credit = USD 0.01); max_credits=0 is a spend barrier, not a free pass. Web UI free tools = manual use only, never automated or scraped.
providers.limitations: Only library search/download may be automated. Record original ID, exact source URL, author, license, date and SHA-256. Respect 429/RateLimit headers.
providers.notes: Prefer this over Poly Haven/ambientCG only when they lack an asset; do not call generate_model/edit_model/generate_texture under the zero-cost policy.

providers.name: Kaggle Notebooks
providers.role: Occasional scheduled/batch experimentation with GPU models
providers.free_tier: GPU notebooks can be submitted and polled via Kaggle CLI/API; free GPU quota and accelerator availability are account-, demand- and policy-dependent. Do not assume a guaranteed weekly allowance or a fixed GPU model. Current CLI supports accelerator selection (e.g. NvidiaTeslaT4) where the user's account is eligible.
constraints: Use the official Kaggle CLI `kaggle kernels push -p <folder>` with a checked-in kernel-metadata.json; store KAGGLE_USERNAME and KAGGLE_KEY only in GitHub Actions Secrets.
Use a private notebook unless the owner explicitly approves public release; enable Internet only when needed and ensure no private credentials are uploaded as notebook input/output.
Check accelerator eligibility/quota before dispatch; record the requested accelerator, actual accelerator, kernel version, start/end time, and outcome.
Tasks must be checkpointable and idempotent; store only final outputs and compact checkpoint state, not large model weights in Git.
Do not rely on exact reset time or a guaranteed GPU queue; handle unavailable quota with DEFERRED_QUOTA and resume later.
No account rotation, no quota evasion and no paid accelerators.
providers.quota: Free GPU (T4/P100) when available; weekly quota is dynamic and must be checked before every push. Do not hardcode a guaranteed weekly number.
providers.license_policy: Notebook content is yours; uploaded data must respect its license. Keep kernels private.
providers.cost_policy: Free tier only; never select paid accelerators.
providers.limitations: Idempotent, resumable tasks only; if no GPU is available mark DEFERRED_QUOTA instead of retry loops. No weights/datasets committed to the game repo.

providers.name: TripoSR — open-source single-image 3D reconstruction model
providers.role: Generate a rough static 3D mesh from an owner-created or properly licensed single-view image, then clean/retopologize/export through Blender.
providers.free_tier: Open-source code and pretrained weights under MIT according to the upstream repository. Upstream README estimates approximately 6 GB VRAM for one image. No paid API is required when self-hosted inside an eligible free GPU notebook.
providers.api_key_required: Kaggle API credentials only if dispatched through Kaggle; no TripoSR service API key
constraints: Different product from the Tripo AI website: use only the open-source TripoSR repository and its MIT-licensed code/weights.
Kaggle free GPU availability is quota- and queue-dependent; no always-on or guaranteed GPU promise.
Best suited to props, rocks, furniture, weapons prototypes and static objects; output requires Blender cleanup, scale/pivot, retopology, UV/material, collision and Godot validation.
Do not assume a one-image reconstruction is a production-ready character, rig or animation.
Input images must be original or licensed for this use; no copyrighted game character references.
Record commit hash, model weight revision, environment lock, input hash, random seed if applicable, output SHA-256 and full license notices.
providers.quota: No service quota (open-source model); execution bound by Kaggle GPU quota when run there.
providers.license_policy: Upstream repository declares MIT for code and weights (https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/TripoSR).
providers.cost_policy: Free software/weights; only free GPU lanes (Kaggle/ZeroGPU/Colab) allowed.
providers.limitations: ~6 GB VRAM per image; rough single-view static reconstruction only — no characters, rigging or animation. Requires Blender cleanup + human review.
providers.notes: First automated GPU experiment: automation/kaggle/ kernel dispatched by asset-gpu-triposr.yml.

notes: Schema 1.1.0 adds the master-prompt required fields (classification, quota, license_policy, cost_policy, limitations, notes, last_verified) to every provider and migrates four providers documented in PR #19 (BlendKit, OpenGameArt, Poly Pizza, Sketchfab). Classification enum: AVAILABLE, LIMITED_QUOTA, MANUAL_ONLY, OPTIONAL, EXPERIMENTAL, REVIEW_LICENSE, DISABLED, PAID, UNKNOWN. Compound 'availability' strings are kept as human detail; 'classification' is the machine field. Zero-cost policy: no purchases, no billing, no card, no account cycling, no calls to providers whose cost is unknown.
